note: The root key records the noun’s own consonants. Its verbal derivation is uncertain.
summary: עֲלָטָה names darkness. In Genesis 15:17 it describes the scene after the sun has set.

senses.definition: The absence of light, here the darkness that follows sunset.

evidence.note: The sun has set when וַעֲלָטָה הָיָה describes the resulting darkness.
